name: Coherence
description: How well the response follows the context and conversation flow

name: Relevance
description: How relevant the response is to the conversation topic

name: Fluency
description: How natural and smooth the response sounds

name: Engagement
description: How engaging and interesting the response is

name: Semantic Similarity
description: How similar the response is to the context in terms of meaning

name: Novelty
description: How unique and original the response is

name: Diversity
description: How diverse the response is in terms of vocabulary and ideas
